changed: Migration 0005 adds action_plans and run_steps tables and nullable plan_id/step_index columns on actions (CHECK set together). RunStore gains put_plan, get_plan and list_steps; every write batch (EventBatch) may carry StepRecords, committed in the same transaction as the events, append-only with a strictly increasing sequence per run. contracts/plan.py defines the $lineage wire form {"$lineage": {"step", "path"}} via LineageRef's serializer and the store-boundary functions plan_to_wire/plan_from_wire; model_validate keeps refusing every literal $lineage key.
open_items: 2c.4: validate_plan revalidates via plan_from_wire(plan_to_wire(plan)); the digest input uses the same encoding (review R-2).
2c.6: refuse an action whose plan_id names no stored plan (review R-5); R-1/R-2 from 2c.2 as planned.
2c.9: model plans need their own placeholder schema; the wire form is never parsed from model output.
Postgres conformance (tests/conformance/test_run_store.py, E_AGENT_TEST_STORE=postgres): 58 passed on a732a12, run by the controller outside the gate (HP-6).

rulings.ruling: Step records are append-only state rows; a status change appends a row with the same step_id and a higher sequence.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An update method and a unique step_id in 2c.6.

rulings.ruling: Batches are Sequence[EventSpec | StepRecord] on every write method; the memory store validates steps before any mutation.
The $lineage wire form is parsed only at the store boundary (plan_from_wire), so model output cannot mint a placeholder (ADR 0025:21).
rulings.cost_if_wrong: 2c.9 defines its own placeholder schema for model plans.

rulings.ruling: Codex hit its usage limit; a Claude reviewer (opus, fresh context) reviewed instead.
